bundle.shortDescription: Track currently-airing anime and get notified when new episodes drop.
bundle.longDescription: AnimeOnTrack tracks currently-airing anime across multiple streaming sites, detects new episodes for the series you follow, and keeps a gap-free record of what you've watched — with a full local AniList catalog for offline browsing and discovery.
